infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Autonomic connects to your heart-rate chest strap to capture beat-to-beat data during HRV readings.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Autonomic reads your pulse through your fingertip placed over the rear camera and flash during camera HRV readings.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Autonomic does not record audio. This permission is required by the camera library used for fingertip pulse readings.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Autonomic reads heart rate, HRV, sleep, blood pressure, blood oxygen, weight and ECG recordings from Apple Health to prefill your journal.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Autonomic can write your captured HRV readings, mindful minutes, weight, blood pressure and blood oxygen back to Apple Health.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Autonomic does not use your location. This permission is required by the Bluetooth library used to connect to heart-rate chest straps.
